entities.summary: Khun Ying Pornthip Rojanasunand, also spelled Porntip Rojanasunan is a Thai forensic pathologist, a former member of the Senate of Thailand and medical doctor. First appearing in the media in 1998, her work and outlandish hairstyles quickly granted her celebrity status, and she became the best known of Thailand's forensic scientists. An author of several best-selling memoirs, her work introduced the Thai public to the role of DNA evidence, among other forensic methods, in crime investigations.
